text:
marta (finance): Heads-up: Nightly NetSuite sync threw 18 rejects. Root cause looks like rounding combo from the pricing experiment (tier + overflow promo). NetSuite error: "Line amount must be >= 0"

josh (eng-billing): any example invoice id we can look at?

marta (finance): invoice_2026_10_02_715 — attaching the webhook payload we sent (sanitized). NetSuite created a compensating credit memo after the retry which now mismatches Stripe net.

anika (revops): argh, that explains the AR variance alert. This was the experiment that applies a step discount plus an overflow negative adj, right?

marta (finance): exactly. two rules combined: step discount -> -X%, and an overflow promo that adds a negative line for the extra usage. decimals + tax calc sometimes push a line to -0.01 after rounding.

billing-bot: webhook_retry: invoice.created invoice_2026_10_02_715 attempts=2 status=400 ns_error="Line amount must be >= 0"

josh (eng-billing): looks like a float precision artifact in the producer. if we round per-line to 2 decimals before emitting, should avoid hitting negative tiny cents.

leo (eng-platform): paste payload? want to check serialization.

marta (finance): here (sanitized):
```json
{
  "id": "invoice_2026_10_02_715",
  "customer": "cus_BAR",
  "lines": [
    {"desc":"usage","qty":1120,"unit_price":0.05,"amount":56.0},
    {"desc":"step discount","amount":-8.4},
    {"desc":"promo overflow adj","amount":-47.60000000000001},
    {"desc":"tax","amount":0.0}
  ],
  "total": 0.0
}
```

josh (eng-billing): that -47.60000000000001 screams JS float. When NetSuite rounds to 2 decimals we get -47.60 and combining with other rounded lines yields a -0.01 line amount in some cases. NetSuite refuses negative final lines.

anika (revops): can we pause experiment notifications and stop automated credit memo creation until we fix? CS should be notified about possible customer-visible memos.

marta (finance): added to cs_queue. two customers already got manual memos in NetSuite that don't map to Stripe transactions; finance ops will need a journal cleanup.

leo (eng-platform): mitigation plan: add server-side normalization in the sync service: 1) coerce decimals to fixed-2 strings, 2) for any line amount where -0.05 < amount < 0 -> set to 0.00 and tag the invoice with metadata "normalized=true". I'll push a staging patch now.

josh (eng-billing): also adding production validation on webhook producer: always emit stringified decimal with 2 decimals and include "rounded_by":"producer" field. Add unit tests for tier+overflow combos.

billing-bot: deploy started: normalize-lines v0.9 -> staging (sha: a7b2c3d)

leo (eng-platform): staging run looks clean on a replay of yesterday's failing set. prepping 5% canary for prod.

anika (revops): please output a list of affected invoice ids to the CS ticket so they can reconcile messaging. I'll draft a short template explaining phantom memos and that we're rolling a fix.

josh (eng-billing): attaching raw webhook payloads for the error set to the ticket. Also flagged experiment to be disabled if any more failures show in the backfill.

marta (finance): follow-ups: cleanup journal entries, run a 72h backfill + reconciliation, and consider a permanent rule to never emit negative line amounts into NetSuite.

leo (eng-platform): will monitor canary and post results in this thread. :eyes: 

billing-bot: deploy succeeded: normalize-lines v0.9 -> staging (sha: a7b2c3d)

leo (eng-platform): rolling canary to prod now at 5% of invoices. will hold full rollout for 3h and check AR metrics.

marta (finance): canary OK with CS notification lead time. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
